services.name: airboat tour
services.desc: Private airboat tours with Airboat Adventures offer an exclusive and customizable way to explore the Louisiana swamps near New Orleans. Whether you’re planning a family outing, birthday party, corporate event, or celebrating with a bachelor or bachelorette group, our fleet includes multiple airboat and boat options designed to accommodate different group sizes and experience styles. All private tours include a licensed local captain, open-air seating, and access to authentic bayou landscapes rich with wildlife and local culture. services.name: pontoon boats
services.desc: Set out on a 20,000-acre (8,095-hectare) tract of tidewater cypress swamp close to the Jean Lafitte National Historical Park and Preserve. Your flat-bottomed boat is leisurely guided through the shallow marshes. Discover bayous lined with mossy cypress and tupelo-gum trees as your captain points out a stunning variety of wildlife. Enjoy a fully narrated tour by a local guide. Prepare to see plenty of alligators in the warmer months (and warmer days in winter), some of which may be sunning themselves on logs!
